children: The exit of a GFL Environmental
investor relations executive is unrelated to the potential sale of the trash hauler.
Mario Cortellacci, vice president of investor relations at GFL, is stepping down, according to an internal memo CTFN reported earlier on Friday. Cortellacci's departure has been in motion since June.
GFL shares were moving higher on Friday as some investors were speculating that his exit could be related to the sales process. The shares closed up 0.4% on Friday.
Cortellacci is leaving the firm to take a role as chief of IR at a company going public, according to the report.
The executive departure comes after GFL on Wednesday said in its Q3 earnings release that the board's special committee has given interested parties a
is now involved in the bidding for the waste management company. The new bidder entered the sale process a few weeks ago and is not affiliated with the two consortia bidding for GFL.
